% PGF decorations.text repeat combined with grouping and ordered reversal.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{decorations.text}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[help lines] (0,-.5) grid (8,1.5);
  \draw[gray,dashed] (0,.5) -- (8,.5);
  \path[decorate,decoration={text effects along path,text={left-right},raise=2pt,
    text effects/.cd,word separator=-,group letters,reverse text,repeat text=1,
    characters={text along path}}]
    (0,.5) .. controls (2,1.5) and (6,-.5) .. (8,.5);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
